propositions: Escaped-defect measurement is unavailable: 648 current bugs lack detected_by metadata (only 7 of 648 bugs have the field), preventing calculation of true bug escape rate or detection-stage efficiency.

Plan-review adoption and churn are high but variable: initial PASS rate is 49.0%, median attempts is 2, p90 is 8, and review-before-claim adoption rose from 29.2% to 79.5% Q2-to-Q3; LLM call volume is 114.72 per accepted completion.

Completion first-pass is 72.3% (722/998), with testing sections and declared file impact correlating with better outcomes (79.7% vs 68.6% and 74.2% vs 67.6%), but causal claims are unsupported by the data.
Code review first-pass is 97.4% but does not discriminate quality; caused_by source attribution is demonstrably noisy and correlates with larger diffs, not code-review effectiveness.

Ticket/DCO/Change-Id discipline reached ~100% adoption in August after 0% in Q2; source diffs decreased (median 111.5→95 lines) and test co-change increased (median 84.5→160.5 lines) Q2-to-Q3, supporting process maturation.
Technical debt risk exists: 35 modules at or above 720 LOC, 15 at or above 780 LOC, 4.09% code duplication, and 47.7% same-file retouch within 24 hours indicate hotspots and forward risk.
